title: Austin Boosts Housing Rental Aid Funds
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors Regular Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation approved expanding an existing contract to increase funding for a vital rental assistance program.
*   This ensures individuals currently receiving tenant-based rental assistance can continue in the program through the end of the fiscal year.
*   The decision provides stability for vulnerable residents and helps prevent displacement by maintaining housing support.
